notes.text:
＊This grammar has the connotation of resolving not to do something.



FORMATION:

Ｖ(dict. form) + まい

Ｖ(minus ます) + まい

ALSO USED:

する -> しまい

くる -> こまい
notes.html:
＊This grammar has the connotation of resolving not to do something.

FORMATION:
Ｖ(dict. form) + まい
Ｖ(minus ます) + まい
ALSO USED:
する -> しまい
くる -> こまい

examples.japanese: 母に言うと心配するから、このことは母に言うまい
examples.body_text:
母に言うと心配するから、このことは母に言うまい 

		If I tell my mother she will worry, so 
		I won't 
		tell her.
examples.body_html:
母に言うと心配するから、このことは母に言うまい 
If I tell my mother she will worry, so I won't tell her.

examples.body_text:
もう言うまい。 

		I'll say no more.
examples.body_html:
もう言うまい。 
I'll say no more.

examples.body_text:
行くまいと決めた。 

		I decided not to go.
examples.body_html:
行くまいと決めた。 
I decided not to go.

examples.japanese: 彼女は慰謝料など払うまいと決心した。
examples.body_text:
彼女は慰謝料など払うまいと決心した。 

		She chose not to pay the consolation money.
examples.body_html:
彼女は慰謝料など払うまいと決心した。  
She chose not to pay the consolation money.

examples.japanese: 彼女は寝るまいと決心しました。
examples.body_text:
彼女は寝るまいと決心しました。 

		She willed herself to keep awake.
examples.body_html:
彼女は寝るまいと決心しました。 
She willed herself to keep awake.

comments.text: Not used in typical spoken Japanese.
comments.html: Not used in typical spoken Japanese.

comments.text:
N.B. Derivation of ~まい involves uncertainty - extension to 'negative violition' arrived the same way as the +ve violition did.  

Therefore, literally, it's more like "I probably won't tell ..." "I don't think I'll tell ..."
comments.html:
N.B. Derivation of ~まい involves uncertainty - extension to 'negative violition' arrived the same way as the +ve violition did.
Therefore, literally, it's more like "I probably won't tell ..." "I don't think I'll tell ..."

comments.text: What about a past tense? How would one say: "He wouldn't tell me." ?
comments.html: What about a past tense? How would one say: "He wouldn't tell me." ?

comments.text:
彼は言わなかっただろう。

I don't think there is a past tense of まい version.

言わないだろう。/ 言わないようにしよう。is more popular spoken style of 言うまい。
